crossRefs.note: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
“If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

translations.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
translations.bsb: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
translations.kjv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
